svg.title: Where it broke, in my first run. Alice's email asked about missing API endpoints. The agent searched memory and found only the Jim fact, at 0.26, then replied to Alice that it would send an update once the docs were revised. It never called manage_memory, so the promise was not saved. Instead it asked John: "Would you like me to schedule a reminder?" When Alice's second email asked for an update, the search found only the Jim fact again, at 0.22, so the agent had to ask John what she had wanted.
